017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp;
018
019import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.http.Content;
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.*;
027
028/**
029 * Drop-in {@link BasicRestServlet} subclass that exposes a single MCP JSON-RPC endpoint at {@code POST /}.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Subclasses provide their {@link McpServerConfig} by overriding {@link #createMcpConfig()} (called once at
033 * {@link #init() init} time), or by registering an {@link McpServerConfig} bean in their {@code RestContext}
034 * bean store.
035 *
036 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
037 * <pre>
038 * @Rest(path="/mcp")
039 * public class MyMcpServlet extends org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20250618.McpRestServlet {
040 *     @Override
041 *     protected McpServerConfig createMcpConfig() {
042 *         return new McpServerConfig()
043 *             .setName("my-server").setVersion("1.0.0")
044 *             .addTool(new MyEchoTool());
045 *     }
046 * }
047 * </pre>
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * The servlet enables {@code addBeanTypes} on its serializer so that polymorphic wire types a
051 * revision emits (content blocks, resource payloads) are tagged with their {@code type}
052 * discriminator, and disables URI resolution ({@code uriResolution="NONE"}) so that JSON-Schema
053 * JSON-Pointer {@code $ref} values (e.g. {@code "#/$defs/text"}) and absolute URIs with fragments
054 * are emitted verbatim rather than rewritten against the servlet path.
055 *
056 * @serial exclude
057 */
058@Rest
059@SerializerConfig(addBeanTypes = "true", uriResolution = "NONE")
060public abstract class AbstractMcpRestServlet extends BasicRestServlet {
061   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
062
063   private final transient AtomicReference<McpServerConfig> config = new AtomicReference<>();
064
065   /**
066    * Returns the {@link McpServerConfig} backing this servlet.
067    *
068    * <p>
069    * The default implementation lazily caches the value of {@link #createMcpConfig()}; subclasses needing
070    * per-request reconfiguration may override.
071    *
072    * <p>
073    * This is invoked on every request, so the cache is published via a lock-free {@link AtomicReference#compareAndSet}
074    * rather than a {@code synchronized} block, avoiding monitor contention on the hot path. Under a first-access
075    * race, {@link #createMcpConfig()} may be invoked by more than one thread, but only one resulting instance is
076    * ever published to {@link #config} and returned to any caller; the others are discarded. This is safe as long
077    * as {@link #createMcpConfig()} is side-effect-free and idempotent (i.e. simply constructs and returns a new
078    * config), which is the documented contract of that method.
079    *
080    * @return The config. Never {@code null}.
081    */
082   public McpServerConfig getMcpConfig() {
083      var c = config.get();
084      if (c == null) {
085         var nc = createMcpConfig();
086         if (nc == null)
087            throw new IllegalStateException("createMcpConfig() returned null");
088         c = config.compareAndSet(null, nc) ? nc : config.get(); // HTT: the CAS-loses branch requires a genuine concurrent first-access race; untestable deterministically.
089      }
090      return c;
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Factory method for the {@link McpServerConfig} backing this servlet.
095    *
096    * <p>
097    * Subclasses must override this method to declare their tools, prompts, and resources.
098    *
099    * @return A non-{@code null} server config.
100    */
101   protected abstract McpServerConfig createMcpConfig();
102
103   /**
104    * The MCP protocol revision this servlet speaks.
105    *
106    * <p>
107    * Supplied by the revision-specific subclass a consumer extends (for example
108    * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20250618.McpRestServlet}); consumers do not normally implement this themselves.
109    *
110    * @return The bound revision. Never {@code null}.
111    */
112   protected abstract McpRevision revision();
113
114   /**
115    * Optional subscription broker backing this servlet's {@code subscriptions/listen} support.
116    *
117    * <p>
118    * Returning <jk>null</jk> (the default) means this servlet does not support subscriptions: no
119    * {@link McpSubscriptionBroker} or {@link McpSubscriptions} bean is added to the request-scoped
120    * {@link BeanStore} that {@link #handleMcp} builds, so any handler or dispatch branch that looks one up
121    * via {@code ctx.getBean(McpSubscriptionBroker.class)} sees {@link java.util.Optional#empty()}.
122    *
123    * <p>
124    * A revision binding that implements {@code subscriptions/listen} (for example
125    * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpRestServlet}) overrides this to return a
126    * memoized broker instance so every request sees the same live subscription registry.
127    *
128    * @return The subscription broker, or <jk>null</jk> if this servlet does not support subscriptions.
129    */
130   protected McpSubscriptionBroker getSubscriptionBroker() {
131      return null;
132   }
133
134   /**
135    * MCP JSON-RPC endpoint.
136    *
137    * @param req The parsed JSON-RPC request envelope.
138    * @param restReq The HTTP request (used to surface the bean store to handlers).
139    * @return The JSON-RPC response, or {@code null} for notifications (which the framework renders as an
140    *         empty body).
141    */
142   @SuppressWarnings({
143      "resource" // Request-scoped scratch BasicBeanStore; lifetime is bounded by this handler invocation, no foreign resources are captured.
144   })
145   @RestPost(path = "/")
146   public Object handleMcp(@Content JsonRpcRequest req, RestRequest restReq) {
147      var bs = new BasicBeanStore(restReq.getContext().getBeanStore())
148         .addBean(RestRequest.class, restReq);
149      var broker = getSubscriptionBroker();
150      if (broker != null)
151         bs.addBean(McpSubscriptionBroker.class, broker).addBean(McpSubscriptions.class, broker);
152      var exchange = new McpExchange(req, n -> restReq.getHeaderParam(n).asString().orElse(null));
153      var result = revision().dispatch(exchange, getMcpConfig(), bs);
154      if (result instanceof McpResponseResult r)
155         return r.response();
156      if (result instanceof McpStreamResult r)
157         return r.stream();
158      return null;
159   }
160}
